description: Menghitung jumlah hari kerja di antara dua tanggal (tidak termasuk akhir pekan, libur nasional, dan opsional cuti bersama). Counts Indonesian working days between two dates, inclusive of both by default. Reversed ranges are swapped.

count_start.description: Count the start date itself. Default true. Set false for "working days after start, up to and including end".

cuti_bersama_off.description: Treat cuti bersama (collective leave) as a day off. Default true. Set false for businesses that work on cuti bersama.

end.description: End date (inclusive). Date as YYYY-MM-DD (also DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, or "today"/"hari ini" in Asia/Jakarta).

saturday_working.description: Saturday is a working day (6-day work week). Default false. National holidays on Saturday stay off.

start.description: Start date. Date as YYYY-MM-DD (also DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, or "today"/"hari ini" in Asia/Jakarta).

name: hitung_hari_kerja
title: Hitung hari kerja / Count working days
